answer: Paid agents are capped at five per network block per epoch, with routing checks confirming each agent arrives from a different residential network before payout. A dune mapping job, a thread sensor repair, and a quartz sample delivery each count under that cap, so 1,000 fake agents would need 200 separate networks instead of one data centre. Renting 200 residential exits costs about 9,000 dollars a month, while one real agent pays nothing extra on its home connection. It is like a market that allows only five stalls per street.
